ModeledStateOrTransition: Initial external crop/body input -> active physiology and first clock
AvailableEvidence: PhysiologyEnabled gives initial crop; initial body energy, hydration and tissue from verified fixture/query
MeasuredEndpoint: Offered diet and day-49 brood counts
MissingDataOrRisk: Offered food does not measure seed body reserves.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Sample adjacent bin ranks then apply living, same-colony, distance and geometry filters
AvailableEvidence: Examined count and optional returned sample opportunity facts
PrimaryLocator: B08 Methods and Table S1; N01 Methods pp. 178-179
MissingDataOrRisk: Contact geometry, all risk-set candidates, physical acceptance, budget and misses not measured.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Social sample, geometry neighborhood or legacy enumeration -> reachable physiology candidate; enforce same-cell when applicable
AvailableEvidence: Native decision work and optional sample members; only resolved target sometimes known
PrimaryLocator: Methods, apparatus and data collection; Fig. S1
MeasuredEndpoint: Timed oral contacts in one chamber
MissingDataOrRisk: Legacy/exhaustive scan is a search implementation with local eligibility; candidate and tissue filters are not an oral encounter.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Exact settled energy, water, crop and larval tissue or queen crop target -> component deficits and conditional cue
AvailableEvidence: State and computed cue recoverable with exact decision-boundary inputs; existing queen trace records a subset
MeasuredEndpoint: State-assigned oral bouts; congener pooled stage enrichment
MissingDataOrRisk: Exact internal receiver knowledge, cue function and quarter thresholds lack direct evidence.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Legacy adult quarter-reserve or larval protein gate and half crop cap, or demand-sensitive overlap and full crop cap -> uniform eligible reservoir pick
AvailableEvidence: NutritionDecision counter and optional Selected; candidate rejection and full denominator absent
PrimaryLocator: B08 Fig. 4 and workbook; N01 Table 2; R1L pp. 157-159 and Figs. 2-3
MeasuredEndpoint: Directed adult contacts, deprivation categories and regurgitation acts
MissingDataOrRisk: Selected recipient != preferential choice conditional on observed alternatives; focal selection weights unidentified.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Owned Rest/Nurse wake -> rest/intake/recycle/gift; gift-first opt-in and urgent self exception; schedule +1 ms
AvailableEvidence: Wake/decision committed; task and success from later facts, not scheduling
MeasuredEndpoint: Frequency and bout duration by diet and participant state
MissingDataOrRisk: Ordering and cadence are fixture choices, not measured activation or transfer duration.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Program hold, travel/stock and actual local demand -> keep/choose Nurse, Rest or alternate work; integrated care lease is distinct
AvailableEvidence: AutonomyDecision and BehaviorChanged; contact samples and stage-specific program cues not fully logged
MeasuredEndpoint: Feeding-visit classes and colony responses to offered diet
MissingDataOrRisk: Task residence and food-visit categories differ. Depot access and aggregate food cannot establish provisioning.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Shared perception boundary -> insert each chosen action, increment counter, optionally emit sample and selection facts
AvailableEvidence: NutritionDecision fact and optional BiologicalObservation keyed by wake; request/target can be present only in pending state
MissingDataOrRisk: Candidates examined is work, sample Opportunity is not physical contact or success, unlogged alternatives are not zeros.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Explicit world-qualified Paused proposal -> pending schedule; actual transfer at resolution
AvailableEvidence: Pending action has actor, target, amount, time and position revision until execution or cancellation
MissingDataOrRisk: No recorded donor recipient choice from an explicit proposal.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Actor and seeded-order validation -> resolver or duplicate/dead/stale/invalid-stage rejection
AvailableEvidence: ActionRejected with source and outcome; generic early rejection may omit kind and recipient
MissingDataOrRisk: Rejection must join a recorded proposal; death and owner cancellation may erase the pending action without a rejection fact.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Settle and recheck live Adult/Larva, contact, exchange, room and ingredient cap against current state
AvailableEvidence: ActionRejected or positive NutritionTransferred. At this boundary recipient payload is set; EmptyInventory can have multiple causes
PrimaryLocator: B08 Methods; N01 pp. 178-181; R1L pp. 157-159 and Figs. 2-3
MeasuredEndpoint: Worker oral events and distinct queen/larval regurgitation acts
MissingDataOrRisk: Eligibility, acceptance and actual pre-state absent from primary observations.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Minimum of requested mass, eligible supply and room -> equal donor crop debit and receiver credit; positive Success or Partial
AvailableEvidence: Actual mass vector, donor, recipient, source, result and order are committed
PrimaryLocator: B08 Table 1 and event workbook; N01 p. 179 and Table 2
MeasuredEndpoint: Oral events, durations and separate meal volume
MissingDataOrRisk: No measured component dose or zeros; 100 ug default is a ceiling, not fixed delivered mass.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Eligible mix -> proportional integer ingredient vector with fixed largest-remainder tie order
AvailableEvidence: Derived from verified supply, room and request; resulting vector recorded
MissingDataOrRisk: Ingredient rule may favor a component in small tied amounts; no empirical composition fractions.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Cargo or physically reachable nest stock -> crop; long-term nurse withdrawal can use maxima of sampled component needs
AvailableEvidence: CargoIngested/NestIngested and amount, or rejection; context-2 sample only in targeted diagnostic
PrimaryLocator: N01 p. 179 ingested-food estimate; B07 Methods §2.2
MissingDataOrRisk: Depot stock is not transferred or absorbed intake; availability, withdrawal and ownership confound outcomes.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Long-term reachable crop protein -> physical nest via ReturnProtein; reschedule separately
AvailableEvidence: ProteinRecycled and actual amount; no direct recipient
MissingDataOrRisk: No measured surplus recycling law. Separate from donor-recipient gift.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Valid completed FeedBrood bout -> same conserved transfer and terminal observation; worker or scoped queen
AvailableEvidence: Actual gift or rejection and care bout, target, outcome, duration when known
MissingDataOrRisk: FeedBrood terminal plus NutritionTransferred may describe one exchange. No focal component dose or uptake.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Owned action -> next wake at configured cadence, or +1 ms after actual nest intake by long-term Nurse
AvailableEvidence: Next event pending and future decision fact; prior behavior/death affects cancellation
MissingDataOrRisk: Scheduler interval is not oral bout length or biological latency.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Elapsed simulation time -> basal/active expenditure, water loss and progress before next operation
AvailableEvidence: Exact detached state and ledger at cuts; per-interval amounts reconstructable with correct state
MissingDataOrRisk: Bulk growth cannot identify energy expenditure, conversion efficiency or hydration kinetics.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Environment wake -> death first, then stage transition, else pulse if due; record actual fact
AvailableEvidence: PhysiologyUpdated with uptake vector, StageChanged or AntDied; event order/clock is needed for ties
MeasuredEndpoint: Two sampling times of congener stage enrichment
MissingDataOrRisk: A death or stage transition is not absorption. Pulse phase priority is an engineering rule.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Crop -> body via per-component capped rate multiplied by pulse interval with persistent remainder; Adult/Larva carbs and water, Larva protein only
AvailableEvidence: Actual consumed vector and modeled after-state; pulse remainder and next time in state
MeasuredEndpoint: Pooled whole-body C/N enrichment at 24/96 h in L. neoniger
MissingDataOrRisk: No separate crop/tissue kinetics, causal uptake lag, adult protein absorption or mixed-crop gift attribution.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Absorbed carbohydrate credited to body energy and oxidation counter at pulse; choose next due time or earlier boundary
AvailableEvidence: Body energy from snapshot and yield times committed carbohydrate vector, water and protein accounted separately
MeasuredEndpoint: Diet/worker counts and congener isotope signal
MissingDataOrRisk: Yield, gross oxidation and onset require separate metabolic evidence. Pulse spacing is numerical.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Queen crop protein plus body energy and water -> funded egg; retained child state and separate dissipation
AvailableEvidence: ReproductionAttempt and AntBorn payloads, funded lineage, same-source IDs, configuration
PrimaryLocator: B03 App. S1 and Fig. 1; R1L pp. 157-159 and Figs. 2-3
MeasuredEndpoint: Foundress brood outcomes and regurgitation contexts
MissingDataOrRisk: Adult crop protein use for egg export is distinct from tissue uptake. No per-gift or egg allocation identified.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Detached settled per-ant copy or global four-component and energy audit at committed cut
AvailableEvidence: Crop, body, loss counters and sums; aggregate residual across seeded and funded individuals
MissingDataOrRisk: Full ledger is global diagnostic only. Aggregate balance does not identify recipient, acceptance or kinetics.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Optional Started/Completed/Interrupted of same resolution; unknown legacy duration and target may be restored from scheduled event
AvailableEvidence: BiologicalObservation with target, phase and outcome where configured
MeasuredEndpoint: Duration is defined by oral contact protocol
MissingDataOrRisk: Zero-length modeled interval is unknown physical duration. Never sum observer and transfer doses.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Thread-local host diagnostic copies chosen action and designated queen snapshots/flags
AvailableEvidence: Existing precommit side trace, written after successful advance in the original harness
MissingDataOrRisk: Queen-only reach/sample flags do not expose every candidate. Invalid target or allocating push can throw.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Environment/perception/resolution transaction -> committed whole cut or rollback
AvailableEvidence: Use committed EventId order and scheduled source IDs; host reads after successful return
MissingDataOrRisk: One timestamp can contain several competing transfers or pulses. Queries after the whole cut alone cannot assign all pre/post states.

ModeledStateOrTransition: Read-only summary and paged event evidence, detached queue when captured
AvailableEvidence: Canonical facts, time, RNG state and ID allocators from summary/checkpoint. Queue full copy at a cut
MissingDataOrRisk: Disappearing work without a recorded terminal cause is unknown unless independently observed. Avoid copying full queues at scale.
